title: Animals And Birds Arabic Summary For The 7th Degree Of The 1st Station

questions.question: Who are working together to show that Allah is One?
questions.answer: All kinds of animals and birds.

questions.question: How many big truths are joined together in this passage?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What do these three truths agree on?
questions.answer: They all point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What does the earth seem like in the passage?
questions.answer: A huge person.

questions.question: What is that huge earth-like person saying?
questions.answer: That there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: Who is this message sent to from the earth?
questions.answer: The people in the heavens.

questions.question: What did the traveler do when he saw this sign?
questions.answer: He understood it clearly.

questions.question: Which living things are named as praising and showing signs of Allah?
questions.answer: Animals and birds.

questions.question: What parts of animals are described like speaking signs?
questions.answer: Their senses, powers, limbs, and body parts.

questions.question: What do the animals’ well-made bodies show about their Maker?
questions.answer: That He creates with order and care.

questions.question: What does forming with wisdom tell us?
questions.answer: Allah gives each creature the right shape in a wise way.

questions.question: Where do many different animals begin in this passage?
questions.answer: From eggs and tiny drops.

questions.question: Are those beginnings very different from each other or often alike?
questions.answer: They are often alike.

questions.question: If many different creatures come from similar small beginnings, what does that help show?
questions.answer: It helps show Allah’s great power and wisdom.

questions.question: What group in the passage gives one shared witness about Allah?
questions.answer: All animal species together.

questions.question: What is the shared witness they give?
questions.answer: That only Allah is truly God.

questions.question: What picture is used for the whole earth?
questions.answer: It is pictured like one giant human.

questions.question: What is the giant earth doing?
questions.answer: It is giving a message of belief.

questions.question: How did the traveler respond to this scene?
questions.answer: He understood its meaning.

questions.question: Besides animals, what other creatures are named with them?
questions.answer: Birds.

questions.question: What inner and outer parts of these creatures are mentioned?
questions.answer: Their senses, strengths, limbs, and tools of the body.

questions.question: Why are these body parts important in the passage?
questions.answer: They show order, skill, and purpose.

questions.question: What three actions of Allah are named about making creatures?
questions.answer: Bringing them into being, giving them special features, and shaping them well.

questions.question: What does shaping them well mean?
questions.answer: Giving them fitting forms in a wise way.

questions.question: What is surprising about the many animal forms?
questions.answer: They come in so many kinds without limit.

questions.question: What small beginnings are mentioned for these many creatures?
questions.answer: Eggs and sperm drops.

questions.question: What is the difference between the beginnings and the results?
questions.answer: The beginnings are limited and similar, but the creatures are many and different.

questions.question: What main lesson should a student learn from this?
questions.answer: Allah alone can make so many different living things so wisely.

questions.question: What do the three truths all join to prove?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: Which creatures are part of this joined proof?
questions.answer: Animals and birds.

questions.question: What is one simple meaning of their “testifying”?
questions.answer: They show signs that point to Allah.

questions.question: Is the earth shown as quiet or as giving a message?
questions.answer: It is shown as giving a message.

questions.question: In the picture from the passage, who hears the earth’s message?
questions.answer: The dwellers of the heavens.

questions.question: What happened in the traveler’s heart and mind when he saw this?
questions.answer: He understood it very well.

questions.question: How are the creatures described as praising Allah?
questions.answer: Through the way they are made.

questions.question: What is said about their senses and powers?
questions.answer: They are balanced and orderly.

questions.question: What is said about their limbs and body parts?
questions.answer: They are complete and meaningful.

questions.question: What does all this order help us know?
questions.answer: That the Creator is wise and powerful.

questions.question: What does it mean that creatures are made by will?
questions.answer: Allah chooses to make them.

questions.question: What does it mean that they are made with purpose?
questions.answer: They are not made for no reason.

questions.question: What does it mean that they are formed with wisdom?
questions.answer: Each one is shaped in the best way for it.

questions.question: What are two starting points named for animal life?
questions.answer: Eggs and tiny drops of sperm.

questions.question: Are those starting points endless or limited?
questions.answer: They are limited.

questions.question: What can we infer when countless living forms come from limited, similar beginnings?
questions.answer: A wise Creator made them.

questions.question: What message do all the animals agree on in this passage?
questions.answer: That Allah is the only true God.

questions.question: What helps make their witness strong?
questions.answer: Three big truths agreeing together.

questions.question: What large object is compared to a person?
questions.answer: The earth.

questions.question: Why is the earth compared to a person here?
questions.answer: To show it is like one great speaker of truth.

questions.question: What was the traveler able to do after seeing this sign?
questions.answer: He grasped its meaning.

questions.question: What two groups of living things are clearly named in the Arabic line and its meaning?
questions.answer: Animals and birds.

questions.question: What do their senses and abilities act like in the passage?
questions.answer: Like clear signs or words.

questions.question: What do these signs point to first about Allah’s action?
questions.answer: He brings creatures into life.

questions.question: What do they point to next about how creatures are made different?
questions.answer: Allah gives each one its own special look.

questions.question: What do they point to about shape and size?
questions.answer: Allah measures and forms them wisely.

questions.question: What kind of forms do animals have in this passage?
questions.answer: Many different and ordered forms.

questions.question: What are those many forms opened from?
questions.answer: From similar eggs and drops.

questions.question: Why is that amazing?
questions.answer: Because so much variety comes from small similar beginnings.

questions.question: Does the passage teach randomness or careful planning?
questions.answer: Careful planning.

questions.question: What is the best short summary of the passage?
questions.answer: All living creatures show that Allah alone creates with wisdom.

questions.question: Who gives a united sign about Allah in this passage?
questions.answer: All species of animals and birds.

questions.question: What belief are they united on?
questions.answer: Allah is One and there is no god but Him.

questions.question: What image helps us imagine the earth speaking?
questions.answer: The earth is pictured like a very big man.

questions.question: What is this big earth-picture saying?
questions.answer: A message of Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Who saw and understood this picture?
questions.answer: The traveler.

questions.question: What parts inside animals are mentioned first?
questions.answer: Their senses and powers.

questions.question: What body parts are mentioned after that?
questions.answer: Their limbs, organs, and other body tools.

questions.question: How are these parts described?
questions.answer: They are orderly, balanced, and complete.

questions.question: If something is orderly and balanced, what does that suggest?
questions.answer: It was made wisely.

questions.question: What does the passage say about creation and will?
questions.answer: Creatures are made by Allah’s choice.

questions.question: What does the passage say about distinction and purpose?
questions.answer: Creatures are given different features for a reason.

questions.question: What does the passage say about measuring and shaping?
questions.answer: These are done with wisdom.

questions.question: What beginnings of life are named?
questions.answer: Eggs and sperm drops.

questions.question: What are those beginnings like compared to one another?
questions.answer: They are alike or close to alike.

questions.question: What does the passage want us to notice about that?
questions.answer: Allah brings endless kinds of life from similar small beginnings.

questions.question: What three truths work together in the passage?
questions.answer: Truths about creating, making things different, and shaping wisely.

questions.question: What do those three truths lead to?
questions.answer: They lead to the truth that Allah is One.

questions.question: Which creatures are speaking this message by their condition and design?
questions.answer: Animals and birds.

questions.question: What giant example from nature is used to show this message?
questions.answer: The whole earth.

questions.question: How is the whole earth described?
questions.answer: Like one huge person.

questions.question: What does that huge person-like earth seem to announce?
questions.answer: That there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: Who is told about this witness from the earth?
questions.answer: The dwellers in heaven.

questions.question: What did the traveler learn from watching all this?
questions.answer: He understood the message fully.

questions.question: What can the senses and powers of animals teach us?
questions.answer: That Allah made them in a measured way.

questions.question: What can the limbs and body parts of animals teach us?
questions.answer: That Allah made them complete and meaningful.

questions.question: What does bringing creatures into being show?
questions.answer: Allah creates by His will.

questions.question: What does giving each creature its own look show?
questions.answer: Allah creates with purpose.

questions.question: What does giving each creature its form and measure show?
questions.answer: Allah creates with wisdom.

questions.question: What two tiny beginnings are named for these creatures?
questions.answer: Eggs and sperm drops.

questions.question: What is one big difference between the beginnings and the final creatures?
questions.answer: The beginnings are few and similar, but the creatures are many and different.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The many signs in animals and birds show Allah’s power, wisdom, and oneness.
